summary: Step 3 of the fork-based browser build: the reader authorizes Google Drive on the preparation page and stores the resulting GDRIVE_OAUTH2 value as a GitHub repository secret, so built APKs are saved to Google Drive. Labels are the preparation page's and GitHub's.

sections.heading: Browser build – Step 3: Authorize Google Drive
sections.summary: Running Google Drive Auth on the preparation page, then adding the GDRIVE_OAUTH2 name and value as a new repository secret on GitHub.
